## Free MSNBC Live Streaming Options

**Note:** MSNBC was rebranded to **MS NOW** in November 2025 as part of Comcast's spin-off into Versant. The same programming continues under the new name.

### Free Streaming Websites

Several websites offer free MSNBC/MS NOW live streaming without requiring a cable subscription:

- **Live News Chat** (livenewschat.eu) - Offers a free 24/7 HD live stream of MS NOW (formerly MSNBC) on any device without signup or app download
- **US News On** (usnewson.com) - Provides free MSNBC/MS NOW live streaming in HD quality
- **Live News Time** (livenewstime.com) - Offers free MSNBC live streaming with optional premium HD service
- **NewsLive.com** (newslive.com) - Allows viewers to watch MSNBC online for free

### Official Streaming Options (May Require Subscription)

- **Peacock** (peacock.com) - NBCUniversal's streaming service that carries MSNBC/MS NOW. Offers both free and premium subscription tiers
- **MSNBC App** - Available for iPhone, iPad, and iPod Touch with live streaming for authenticated cable/satellite subscribers

### Streaming Services with Free Trials

If you want legitimate access through official channels, these services offer MSNBC/MS NOW and typically have free trials:

- **Sling TV** - Offers MSNBC in its channel packages
- **Hulu + Live TV** - Includes MSNBC in its live TV bundle
- **YouTube TV** - Carries MS NOW (formerly MSNBC)
- **fuboTV** - Includes MSNBC in its lineup
- **DIRECTV Stream** - Offers MSNBC/MS NOW

### Important Considerations

- Many "free" streaming sites operate in legal gray areas and may contain ads or unreliable streams
- For the most reliable and legal experience, official streaming services or TV provider authentication is recommended
- The network's programming remains the same despite the name change to MS NOW
